00044 AmplitudeBaseUGenInternal::AmplitudeBaseUGenInternal(UGen const& input, 
00045                            const float durationToUse) throw()
00046 : UGenInternal(NumInputs),
00047   duration(durationToUse)
00048 {
00049   ugen_assert(durationToUse > 0.f);
00050   
00051   inputs[Input] = input;
00052   
00053   measureLength = ugen::max(1, (int)(UGen::getSampleRate() * duration));
00054   measuredItems = 0;
00055   maximum = 0.f;
00056   oldMaximum = 0.f;
00057   currentAmplitude = 0.f;
00058 }
00059 
00060 void AmplitudeBaseUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00061 {
00062   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00063   float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00064   float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00065   
00066   while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00067   {
00068     float input = *inputSamples;
00069     
00070     if(abs(input) > maximum) 
00071       maximum = abs(input);
00072     
00073     measuredItems++;
00074     
00075     if(measuredItems == measureLength)
00076     {
00077       currentAmplitude = maximum;
00078       measuredItems = 0;
00079       maximum = 0.f;
00080     }
00081     
00082     float output = currentAmplitude;
00083     
00084     *outputSamples = output;
00085     
00086     outputSamples++;
00087     inputSamples++;
00088   }
00089 }

00097 UGenInternal* AmplitudeUGenInternal::getChannel(const int channel) throw()
00098 {

00100                                 duration);
00101   internal->measuredItems = measuredItems;
00102   internal->maximum = maximum;

00104   internal->currentAmplitude = currentAmplitude;
00105   return internal;
